final: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1.0 WHEN c.gender IS NOT NULL THEN 0.0 END) / COUNT(c.client_id) FROM client AS c JOIN district AS dc ON c.district_id = dc.district_id JOIN account AS a ON a.district_id = dc.district_id JOIN disp AS p ON p.client_id = c.client_id AND p.account_id = a.account_id WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
